verdicts.title: Solution of the self-dual $Φ^4$ QFT-model on four-dimensional Moyal space
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Previously the exact solution of the planar sector of the self-dual $Φ^4$-model on 4-dimensional Moyal space was established up to the solution of a Fredholm integral equation. This paper solves, for any coupling constant $λ>-\frac{1}π$, the Fredholm equation in terms of a hypergeometric function and thus completes the construction of the planar sector of the model. verdicts.title: Free-fermion models and the two-dimensional Ising models under the zero field and imaginary field $i(π/2){k_B}T$
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Ising model is famous in condensed matter and statistical physics. In this work we present a free-fermion formulation of the two-dimensional classical Ising models on the honeycomb, triangular and Kagomé lattices. Each Ising model is studied in the cases of a zero field and of an imaginary field $i(π/2){k_B}T$. verdicts.title: Testing Cluster Structure of Graphs
